title: Trouble in public school and the Catholic mission school
summary: Distracted by show business, he fights on his first day, is moved by his mother to a Catholic school, and cannot be converted.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, these things all excited me. After that, I wasn't much good for education. So, we come back to Philadelphia and I wasn't doing so well in public school. In fact, I went to the public school and the first day I was there, I got into a

fight. A guy hit me with an orange peel, and we went to fight, and Old Man Jacobs of Jen Kins Quince and Pine [streets] told me after lunch, that that evening he was going to take care of me. So, I told my mother, and she said, "You're not going back there any more for him to take care of you. I'm going to put you in the Catholic School." At that time, it was a Catholic school, at 12th and Lombard. And this school was more missionary in those days. All the Catholic schools for blacks were missionaries mostly.

And so, I went to this school clean up until I was six years old and I turned out fairly good there, because for two years I didn't miss a Mass, and -- but they couldn't convert me, for some reason. In fact, I've been struggling to try to be converted up 'til now, and so far I haven't been successful. So, anyhow, as things went on, I began to take to thinking of Bert Williams and George Walker, and Vaughan, I began to think about them so much that I wasn't doing much in school.
